description: A set of toggles that share one value, for formatting controls, alignment options and segmented controls.
overview:
`ToggleGroup` is built on the toggle group primitive and lays out `ToggleGroupItem` toggles in a row or a column. Items take the same `variant` and `size` styles as Toggle. The `spacing` prop sets the gap between items in steps of 4 points.

With `spacing={0}`, the group changes shape: the `default` variant becomes a segmented control on a `bg-control` track, and the `outline` variant joins items into one bordered strip. In a single-selection segmented control, the selected item is marked by a raised indicator that slides to the new item when the selection changes, like Tabs. In a `multiple` segmented control, each pressed item is raised on its own. Use the segmented style for switching views and the spaced style for toolbars.
usage:
The value is always an array of strings. Use `value` and `onValueChange` for controlled use, or `defaultValue`. Set `multiple` to allow more than one pressed item; without it, pressing an item replaces the selection.

Give each `ToggleGroupItem` a `value`. Put icons in a `ToggleGroupIcon`, which sizes them to 16 points, and give icon-only items an `accessibilityLabel`. `orientation` switches between a row and a column, and `disabled` on the group turns off every item.

examples.Attached: Outlined items joined into one strip with `spacing={0}`.
examples.Segmented: A single-selection segmented control for calendar views.
examples.SegmentedVertical: The segmented control in a vertical orientation.
examples.SegmentedMultiple: A segmented control that allows several selected items.
examples.SingleSelection: Outlined alignment options where only one item can be pressed.
examples.Vertical: Joined outline items stacked in a column.

parts.ToggleGroup: Container that holds the shared value.
parts.ToggleGroupIcon: Icon sized for a toggle group item.

ToggleGroup.value: Pressed item values for controlled use.
ToggleGroup.defaultValue: Initially pressed item values for uncontrolled use.
ToggleGroup.onValueChange: Called with the new array of pressed values.
ToggleGroup.multiple: Allows more than one item to be pressed.
ToggleGroup.variant: Item style for the whole group: `default` or `outline`.
ToggleGroup.size: Item size for the whole group: `default`, `sm` or `lg`.
ToggleGroup.spacing: Gap between items in steps of 4 points. `0` joins the items. Defaults to `2`.

ToggleGroupItem.value: Value added to the group value when the item is pressed.
ToggleGroupItem.variant: Accepted on the item, but the group's `variant` takes precedence.
ToggleGroupItem.size: Accepted on the item, but the group's `size` takes precedence.

accessibility:
- A single-selection group has the `radiogroup` role and its items have the `radio` role.
- A `multiple` group has the `group` role and its items have the `togglebutton` role.
- Items report checked and disabled states to VoiceOver and TalkBack.
- The sliding segmented indicator is hidden from VoiceOver and TalkBack.
- Icon-only items need an `accessibilityLabel`; label the group itself with `accessibilityLabel` when its purpose is not clear from context.
notes:
- Pressed items use `bg-item-selected` and `text-link`; the segmented indicator and pressed segmented items use `bg-surface-raised` with a small shadow in light mode and `bg-label-quaternary` in dark mode.
- The indicator slides over 300 ms and respects the system reduce motion setting. It is hidden when the selected item is disabled.
- Colors follow the system appearance.
